details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> ui: share conversations to Hugging Face datasets as agent traces (#32608) * ui: add @ggml-org/llama-huggingface, a Hugging Face account as a package A package in ui/lib that gives an app running in the browser, with no server of its own, a Hugging Face account. Its plain entry holds "Sign in with Hugging Face" (OAuth with PKCE and dynamic client registration) and the Hub calls: who the account is, its datasets, and committing a trace file to one. Its Svelte entry holds the account as state (HfAccount) and the components that show it, built on Llama UI: the account panel and the dialog that shares a trace. It knows no app: the app says who it is and hands over what to share. Llama Chat compiles it from source, like the other packages, so the llama-server image builds (.devops) and the asset staging (scripts/ui-assets.cmake) copy its sources next to the other packages'. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> metal : check all fused nodes for concurrency (#33175) * metal : check all fused nodes for concurrency The concurrency check for a fused group only examined the last node, so intermediate outputs (e.g. the TOPK_MOE ids/weights) and the group's sources (e.g. the router logits) were ignored. This allowed the fused top-k kernel to run concurrently with the router matmul that writes its input, producing nondeterministic expert routing. Check every node of the fused group instead. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> graph : read recurrent states in place instead of copying (#28841) (#30139) * graph : read recurrent states in place instead of copying (#28841) This is a graph only change that speeds up token output in the majority of cases and backends by removing state copy steps. Where possible, kernels now read recurrent states directly from the cache instead of a copy from ggml_get_rows. A change to RWKV6/7 makes it read its old state before overwriting. A graph-reuse check condition is added to keep track of whether states are read in place. Assisted-by: Claude Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 * graph : keep recurrent-state graph the same shape, both when read in place or for movement Vulkan and Metal failed under GGML_SCHED_NO_REALLOC. The readers now always read the states from cache. Graph shape is mainmtained throughout. Assisted by: Opus 5.5 * Prevent any throughput regressions from caching clashing with speculative decoding rollback snapshots. Fix WebGPU CI error by skipping the fusion s

details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> vulkan: further optimize coopmat2 GDN (#32860) * vulkan: further optimize coopmat2 GDN Refactor split+store callbacks so hi and lo portions are all stored together. This should help allow the stores to be vectorized. Interleave the state store callbacks with the gram_pmat work. The compiler doesn't seem to let these things overlap without manual effort like this. I suspect this is because the compiler doesn't have smart enough alias analyssis to know what can/can't conflict. Similarly, split the invert function into separate calculation/store calls, so the inverse work can interleave better with the MMAs. Move "solved" from sh_dh to sh_sh - reusing sh_dh needed a barrier but sh_sh doesn't. * interact properly with new replay code </details> **Website:** - <https://llama.app> **Attestations:** - <https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/attestations/73327803> **macOS/iOS:** - [macOS Apple Silicon (arm64)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b12821/llama-b
